## Today

`HomeViewModel`'s `init` block already calls
`recordedRaceSyncService.sync(raceInProgress = false, at = clock.now())`
from a second collector, on `linkStateMonitor.observeLinkEstablished()`
(app-wear/src/main/java/com/mgilli/app_wear/home/HomeViewModel.kt,
lines 78-84) — separate from the button's own call in
`onSyncClicked` (line 141-147). `LinkStateMonitor.observeLinkEstablished`
(core-sync/src/main/kotlin/com/mgilli/core/sync/link/LinkStateMonitor.kt)
emits on every not-established-to-established transition, not once.

`RecordedRaceSyncService.sync` (core-domain/.../sync/RecordedRaceSyncService.kt)
reads `raceRecordingRepository.observeRecorded()` on every call and
sends every race still in that list. `RaceRecordingRepository.markSent`
never removes a race from `observeRecorded()` — only `eraseRecorded`
does, once the phone acknowledges receipt. A race whose send failed is
never marked sent, so it stays in `observeRecorded()` and is sent again
the next time `sync` runs — including the next
`observeLinkEstablished()` emission. So a sync that stopped on a
failure is already retried at the next established link, through the
same mechanism that fires the sync in the first place.
